stops.name: Lysefjord Center
stops.detail: Information on the topics of culture, geography, and nature can be found at the Lysefjord Center in Oanes at the beginning of the Lysefjord in Ryfylke.

stops.name: Fantehola
stops.detail: Nearby lies Fantehola, a cave with a waterfall.

days.title: The High Peaks and Fjord's End
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Kjerag
stops.detail: About 5 kilometers before the end of the Lysefjord in Ryfylke stands the highest rock wall, the Kjerag.

stops.name: Kjeragkeil
stops.detail: The Kjeragkeil, a large stone wedged between two rock walls, can also be seen here.

stops.name: Lysebotn
stops.detail: At the end of the Lysefjord lies the settlement of Lysebotn.

stops.name: Øygardsstølen
stops.detail: At the end of the road lies the former mountain farm Øygardsstølen (also called Ørneredet – Eagle's Nest), where a cafe is located today with a beautiful view of the Lysefjord and the road to Lysebotn.
